notes: Deploys the three Marginalia companion implementations on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1): src/MarginaliaRouter.sol, src/MarginaliaJudge.sol and src/MarginaliaTreasury.sol. Each is an EIP-1167 implementation target with a nonpayable constructor that takes no arguments and calls no other contract, so the three entries carry empty constructorArgs and have no dependency on one another; the order above is only the order the later hook wires them in. Every constructor fills its own init guard with its own address (the judge also sets its placeholder oracle signer to itself), so the published implementations can never be initialised or pointed at a hook: init reverts AlreadyInitialised on them (test/Companions.t.sol testImplementationsCannotBeInitialised). No contract has an owner, a pause, an upgrade path, a withdraw or any privileged caller; nothing is written to storage by the deployment beyond those guards, and the launch sends no ETH and makes no initialization call. A later univ4_hook launch (MarginaliaHook) clones all three with OpenZeppelin Clones.clone in its constructor and calls each clone's one-shot init: router init(poolManager, hook), judge init(hook, intake, action, signer), treasury init(hook). The hook constructor requires code at all three implementation addresses before cloning, so src/MarginaliaImpls.sol must be updated from its rehearsal placeholders to the three addresses this launch produces before the hook launch builds. What the clones do: MarginaliaRouter posts notes by swapping IMD for MARG with hookData through the v4 PoolManager, optionally trading any ERC-20 on Uniswap v4, v3 or v2 in the same transaction, requiring the note to be about the token traded; v3 pools and v2 pairs must be the ones the canonical mainnet factories (0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984, 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f) know, checked on use. The 0.25% action fee is not in this version. MarginaliaJudge is the IdentityMD oracle consumer (EIP-712 domain "IdentityMD Oracle" version 2): once a week, when the week's thesis pool holds at least 2 IMD, anyone can have it draw the Intake's live price (reference 0.5 IMD, paid as quoted up to twice that) from the pool and buy the panel ranking (panel 7, quorum 5) of the week's long-form theses through the Intake at 0x1397434cd35e8a9C8aC312A61D3A285EB31dea56; the verified callback tells the hook which three theses to pay 50/30/20. A week allows one request and one retry after a 3-day unanswered timeout; a ranking naming no thesis rolls the pool forward. MarginaliaTreasury holds IMD and lets anyone drip 2% of its IMD balance into the hook's pot once per UTC day; it has no receive function and no withdraw. Addresses the clones use come from the hook, not from this launch: PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90, IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, the Intake above. No token or pool is deployed here. The runtimes contain no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and stay under the EIP-170 size limit.
